description: This file defines types and constants related to Kubernetes API authentication, including TokenReview, TokenRequest, UserInfo, and SelfSubjectReview, along with associated metadata and documentation.

classes.name: TokenReview
classes.description: Represents a request to authenticate a token to a known user.

classes.name: TokenReviewSpec
classes.description: Details of the token authentication request.

classes.name: TokenReviewStatus
classes.description: Result of the token authentication request.

classes.name: UserInfo
classes.description: Contains user identity information used in authentication.

classes.name: ExtraValue
classes.description: Type alias for a slice of strings representing extra user info.

classes.name: TokenRequest
classes.description: Represents a request for a service account token.

classes.name: TokenRequestSpec
classes.description: Parameters for creating a token request.

classes.name: TokenRequestStatus
classes.description: Result of a token request, including the token and expiration.

classes.name: BoundObjectReference
classes.description: Reference to an object that a token is bound to, such as a Pod or Secret.

classes.name: SelfSubjectReview
classes.description: Contains user info about the requester, with impersonation support.

classes.name: SelfSubjectReviewStatus
classes.description: Holds the user info returned by the server.

methods.name: ExtraValue.String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of ExtraValue.
